scope.ffn_unit: gate_proj + up_proj + down_proj as one layer-level unit

proxy.representation_note: Quantized payloads count input-channel padding and one FP16 scale per group; FP16 counts direct weights only; packed headers are not modeled.

calibration.selection_method: randomized evenly spaced token buckets with non-overlap rejection

heldout.selection_method: randomized evenly spaced token buckets with non-overlap rejection

data.limitation: Wikitext is a language-quality proxy; this phase does not use a small HellaSwag subset as a decision criterion.

w8_centered_marginals.definition: one unit changed from W8 while every other Q/K/V/O/FFN unit remains W8; actual combined calibration execution for W4 and FP16

projection_enumeration.description: exhaustive projection-only enumeration across all 3^5 = 243 assignments in exploration; skipped only for the gated 8B confirmation

storage.representation: FP16 direct or symmetric groupwise fake-quantized payload; no packed metadata

interaction_aware_search.candidate_generation: bounded deterministic beam/coordinate search from W8; includes explicit feasible 8->4 plus compensating 8->16 moves and recomputes moves around accepted profiles
interaction_aware_search.ranking: stable_rank_score from actual shard NLL deltas, then worst shard and shard dispersion; deterministic signature tie-break

rounds.ranking: actual combined calibration stable_rank_score, then worst shard, then shard std, then signature
